reason:
The kill condition required a single cell with positive Calmar on at least five of the nine symbols and a liquidation on none. Six of the nine - SOLUSDT -0.0399, AVAXUSDT -0.0612, BNBUSDT -0.1249, ADAUSDT -0.1677, ETHUSDT -0.1691, DOGEUSDT -0.2928 - have no positive cell anywhere in the 108-cell grid. Counting the 108 cells across the nine symbols, the best any SINGLE cell manages is TWO symbols (e.g. lookback 21d / enter 0.0002 / leverage 0.25 / max_hold 30d: BTCUSDT +0.0763 and LTCUSDT +0.0907). Five is not merely unreached, it is arithmetically unreachable. The condition is met and the family closes.

The first closing note said the ceiling was three; the post-mortem recounted and it is two, because the three positive symbols peak at three DIFFERENT parameter sets. The numbers here are re-derived on code_hash a7e54b0f58c9a7cd, after the lookahead fix (the exit scan started at the fill bar, so the fill bar's own extremes could trigger a stop the position never saw) and the entry-bar funding fix. Both moved every Track B figure - LTCUSDT went +0.0464 to +0.0907 - and neither moved the conclusion.

What happened to the three positives is the more informative part. All three are shape SPIKE sitting in negative neighbourhoods: the mean of the cells adjacent to the peak is -0.115 for BTCUSDT, -1.867 for LTCUSDT and -4.772 for XRPUSDT. A peak whose neighbours are an order of magnitude worse and of the opposite sign is a grid corner, not a mechanism, and the winning parameters say the same thing: they cluster at the extreme of every axis the grid offered - the richest entry rate 0.0002 on eight of nine symbols, the smallest exposure 0.25 on eight of nine. PBO is 0.647 on XRPUSDT, above the 0.5 line at which selection carries no information at all, and 0.317 and 0.385 on BTCUSDT and LTCUSDT: SELECTION_WEAK, not informative. Each symbol is one equity curve over one history, with an independent-path bound between 2 and 56.

Two measurements outside the grid close it past argument. Walk-forward on the BTCUSDT winner retains 8.9 per cent of its edge: in-sample Calmar 1.790, out-of-sample 0.159. And re-running that same cell on minute bars, the final equity of 13,796 dollars contains 4,194 of collected funding, which puts the price-and-cost leg at MINUS 398 - on hourly bars it looked like plus 3,576. The profit is entirely coupon and the short leg is a net loss, taken at a 68.2 per cent drawdown. The regime split says it a third way: annualised -33.0 per cent in rising markets against +122.9 per cent in falling ones. This was never carry. It was a short.

The mechanism failed for the reason the pre-registered claim itself named as the open question: whether the tax could be collected without the directional move that produces it taking the position first. It cannot. Shorting a rich trailing settlement rate puts the coupon and the directional exposure on opposite sides of the book by construction - the rule is short exactly when leveraged long demand is strongest, which is exactly when price is rising. Funding at the 0.01 per cent baseline is roughly 11 per cent a year; the adverse move over a holding period of days to weeks is a multiple of that. No combination of stop, exposure or holding limit in the grid separated the two, and the failure is monotone across the universe rather than concentrated in one symbol or one regime. KT-1 established that long perpetual accumulation pays a structural tax. H0002 establishes that standing on the receiving side of that same tax, unhedged and short-only, does not collect it.
